Dear Fitz,
Re: Mr Lyle Will, DOB 22.9.2006

He lives alone, is single, has a niece who helps (Ms June Bright, who has power of attorney, phone 828-555-0146). He was a smoker until recently and has coronary disease, prostate carcinoma in situ managed conservatively, and takes simvastatin 20 mg, metoprolol succinate 100 mg and a nitroglycerin spray. Bloods are at goal. Glucose sixty-seven in December 2088 was low and I have asked the nurse to repeat it.
Kind regards, Everett Strand-Mbeki EsM/dd (typed by dd) cc: patient, Ms Bright
